findings.note: A RotoWire note from Nov 4, 2026 says Kapanen has moved into Podkolzin's spot on Edmonton's top power-play unit, which could raise his shot volume. The same note lists 23 shots in 16 games (about 1.4 per game), so his season pace still sits below 1.5.

RotoWire notes on this page flag his 'limited shot volume' (Oct 29) and show several two-shot games this season. His first-unit power-play time earlier depended on Hyman and Nugent-Hopkins being injured, and one note said he may slip to the third line once the team is healthy.

On Nov 5, 2026 against the Ducks, Kapanen scored a power-play goal on three shots, so he went over 1.5 in a recent game while playing on the power play. I found no reporting from game day (Nov 15) on Edmonton's lines, his status, or analyst picks for this market.
